seo.metaDescription: Thực sử dụng các mẫu câu đơn giản để hỏi và trả lời.

IF.IFdes:
"MỤC TIÊU
THUẦN THỤC trả lời các câu hỏi sau (1) Bằng dạng văn bản; (2) nói trực tiếp với giáo viên
Theo format [Câu trả lời | Câu mở rộng | Câu kết mở]
"
"Person|
1 /Who are you closest to in your family?
2 /Do you have a close friend?
3 /Who do you usually spend your free time with?
4 /Who do you usually talk to when you have a problem?
5 /Is there anyone you really admire?
6 /Who has influenced you the most in your life?
7 /Have you met anyone interesting recently?
8 /Do you enjoy meeting new people?
9 /Is it easy for you to make new friends?
10 /How often do you spend time with your friends?
11 /What do you usually do with your friends?
12 /What qualities do you look for in a good friend?
13 /What kind of people do you enjoy spending time with?
14 /Do you prefer spending time with older or younger people? Why?
15 /Do you think it's important to have good friends? Why?
16 /Do you think teachers can influence students' lives?
17 /Would you like to work with your friends in the future? Why or why not?
18 /Has your relationship with your friends changed over the years?
19 /Do people make friends in the same way as they did in the past?
20 /What makes someone a good leader, teacher, or role model?"
"Place|
1	What is your favourite place in your hometown?
2	Is there a place you often go to in your free time?
3	Where do you usually go when you want to relax?
4	What is the most interesting place you have ever visited?
5	Is there a place you would like to visit again? Why?
6	What place would you recommend to tourists visiting your country?
7	Which place do you visit most often?
8	What place do you usually go to with your friends or family?
9	Is there a place that is special to you? Why?
10	What kind of places do you enjoy visiting?
11	Are there any places you don't like visiting? Why?
12	Do you prefer spending time in quiet places or crowded places? Why?
13	Have you visited any new places recently?
14	What place would you like to visit in the future?
15	Do you think your hometown is a good place to live? Why or why not?
16	Has your hometown changed much over the years?
17	Do you enjoy exploring new places? Why or why not?
18	Which place do you usually choose for studying or working?
19	Do you think people should spend more time outdoors? Why?
20	If you had a whole day off, where would you choose to go? Why?"
"Object|
1	What is your favourite object that you use every day?
2	What is one thing you couldn't live without?
3	What object do you use most often during the day?
4	Do you own anything that is very important to you?
5	What was the last useful thing you bought?
6	Is there an object you always carry with you?
7	What object do you use most at home?
8	What object helps you the most in your daily life?
9	Is there something you use every day but don't really like?
10	Have you ever received a useful object as a gift?
11	What object do you spend the most money on?
12	Is there an object you would like to replace in the future?
13	What object do you usually take with you when you travel?
14	What object is the most useful for studying or working?
15	Do you prefer buying practical objects or fashionable ones? Why?
16	Do you usually take good care of your belongings?
17	Have you ever lost something important?
18	Do you think people own too many things nowadays? Why or why not?
19	What object do you think has changed people's lives the most?
20	If you could invent a new everyday object, what would it be?"
"Activity|
1	What activity do you enjoy doing the most in your free time?
2	What activity do you do every day?
3	What activity helps you relax after a busy day?
4	What activity do you usually do at the weekend?
5	Is there an activity you never get bored of?
6	What activity do you usually do with your friends or family?
7	What activity takes up most of your time?
8	What activity do you find the most challenging?
9	Have you started any new activities recently?
10	Is there an activity you would like to do more often?
11	What activity did you enjoy when you were a child?
12	Is there an activity you no longer do? Why?
13	What activity makes you feel productive?
14	What activity do you usually do to stay healthy?
15	Do you prefer doing activities alone or with other people? Why?
16	What activity do you think is most important for students?
17	Do you think people have enough time for leisure activities nowadays? Why or why not?
18	Has the way you spend your free time changed over the years?
19	What activity would you like to learn in the future?
20	If you had more free time, what activity would you spend more time on?"
"Event|
1	What is your favourite event of the year?
2	What event do you look forward to the most every year?
3	Have you attended any interesting events recently?
4	What was the last event you attended?
5	Do you enjoy celebrating your birthday? Why or why not?
6	What family event do you enjoy the most?
7	What public event do people in your country enjoy attending?
8	Is there an event that you never miss?
9	What event would you like to attend again?
10	Have you ever taken part in a large event?
11	What event has been the most memorable in your life?
12	What kind of events do you usually attend?
13	Do you prefer small events or large events? Why?
14	Do you enjoy attending cultural festivals? Why or why not?
15	Have the events people attend changed compared with the past?
16	Do you think festivals are important for a country? Why?
17	What event would you like to experience in the future?
18	If you could attend any event in the world, what would it be?
19	Do you prefer celebrating important events with family or friends? Why?
20	Do you think people spend too much money on celebrations nowadays? Why or why not?"
"Time|
1	What time do you usually get up on weekdays?
2	What time do you usually go to bed?
3	What time of day do you feel most productive?
4	What time do you usually have breakfast?
5	How long does it usually take you to get to work or school?
6	How much time do you spend studying English each week?
7	How often do you exercise?
8	How often do you meet your friends?
9	How often do you visit your relatives?
10	When do you usually do your homework or study?
11	When do you usually have your free time?
12	What is your favourite time of the year? Why?
13	What is your favourite time of the day? Why?
14	Do you prefer doing important tasks in the morning or in the evening? Why?
15	Have your daily routines changed over the past few years?
16	Do you think you manage your time well? Why or why not?
17	Is there a time of the week that you enjoy the most?
18	When was the last time you learned something new?
19	How much time do you usually spend using your mobile phone each day?
20	If you had one extra hour every day, how would you spend it?"

TV.TV-01: Câu hỏi
TV.TV-03: Bạn tôi
TV.TV-04: Giáo viên của tôi
TV.TV-05: Bố tôi
TV.TV-06: Sếp của tôi

TV.TV-01: Anh ấy/Cô ấy là ai?
TV.TV-03: Anh ấy là bạn thân nhất của tôi từ thời đại học.
TV.TV-04: Cô ấy là giáo viên tiếng Anh của tôi tại một trung tâm ngôn ngữ.
TV.TV-05: Anh ấy là bố tôi.
TV.TV-06: Anh ấy là quản lý của tôi tại nơi làm việc.

TV.TV-01: Bạn biết anh ấy/cô ấy như thế nào?
TV.TV-03: Chúng tôi đã quen biết nhau khoảng sáu năm.
TV.TV-04: Cô ấy đã dạy tôi tiếng Anh hơn một năm.
TV.TV-05: Tôi biết anh ấy cả đời vì anh ấy là bố tôi.
TV.TV-06: Tôi gặp anh ấy khi tôi gia nhập công ty hai năm trước.

TV.TV-01: Anh ấy/Cô ấy như thế nào?
TV.TV-03: Anh ấy thân thiện, vui tính và rất hỗ trợ.
TV.TV-04: Cô ấy kiên nhẫn, hiểu biết và luôn động viên.
TV.TV-05: Anh ấy chăm chỉ, có trách nhiệm và tốt bụng.
TV.TV-06: Anh ấy chuyên nghiệp, có tổ chức và khắt khe nhưng công bằng.

TV.TV-01: Anh ấy/Cô ấy làm nghề gì?
TV.TV-03: Anh ấy làm kỹ sư phần mềm.
TV.TV-04: Cô ấy dạy tiếng Anh cho thanh thiếu niên và người lớn.
TV.TV-05: Anh ấy điều hành doanh nghiệp nhỏ của riêng mình.
TV.TV-06: Anh ấy quản lý bộ phận marketing của chúng tôi.

TV.TV-01: Bạn gặp nhau thường xuyên như thế nào?
TV.TV-03: Chúng tôi gặp nhau gần như mỗi cuối tuần.
TV.TV-04: Tôi gặp cô ấy hai lần một tuần ở lớp.
TV.TV-05: Tôi gặp anh ấy mỗi ngày vì chúng tôi sống cùng nhau.
TV.TV-06: Tôi gặp anh ấy mỗi ngày làm việc.

TV.TV-01: Các bạn thường làm gì cùng nhau?
TV.TV-03: Chúng tôi thường uống cà phê, chơi cầu lông hoặc xem phim cùng nhau.
TV.TV-04: Chúng tôi thảo luận bài học, luyện nói và ôn tập bài tập về nhà.
TV.TV-05: Chúng tôi ăn tối cùng nhau và nói chuyện về công việc và gia đình.
TV.TV-06: Chúng tôi thảo luận dự án, tham dự các cuộc họp và giải quyết các vấn đề liên quan đến công việc.

TV.TV-01: Tại sao anh ấy/cô ấy lại quan trọng với bạn?
TV.TV-03: Anh ấy luôn hỗ trợ tôi mỗi khi tôi gặp khó khăn.
TV.TV-04: Cô ấy đã giúp tôi cải thiện tiếng Anh và trở nên tự tin hơn.
TV.TV-05: Anh ấy đã dạy tôi nhiều bài học quan trọng trong cuộc sống và luôn ủng hộ tôi.
TV.TV-06: Anh ấy đã giúp tôi phát triển các kỹ năng chuyên môn và tích lũy kinh nghiệm quý báu.

TV.TV-01: Bạn có thể kể cho tôi về một trải nghiệm đáng nhớ không?
TV.TV-03: Chúng tôi từng cùng nhau đi du lịch Đà Nẵng và có một chuyến đi khó quên.
TV.TV-04: Cô ấy đã động viên tôi trước một bài thuyết trình tiếng Anh quan trọng, điều đó đã giúp tôi thể hiện tốt.
TV.TV-05: Anh ấy đã dạy tôi cách đi xe đạp khi tôi còn nhỏ.
TV.TV-06: Anh ấy tin tưởng giao cho tôi dẫn dắt một dự án quan trọng, và đó là một trải nghiệm học hỏi tuyệt vời.

TV.TV-01: Bạn thích điều gì nhất ở anh ấy/cô ấy?
TV.TV-03: Tôi thích nhất sự trung thực và khiếu hài hước của anh ấy/cô ấy.
TV.TV-04: Tôi ngưỡng mộ sự kiên nhẫn và phong cách giảng dạy của anh ấy/cô ấy.
TV.TV-05: Tôi tôn trọng trách nhiệm và sự tận tâm của anh ấy/cô ấy đối với gia đình chúng tôi.
TV.TV-06: Tôi đánh giá cao khả năng lãnh đạo và sự sẵn lòng hỗ trợ nhóm của anh ấy/cô ấy.

TV.TV-01: Bạn sẽ giữ liên lạc trong tương lai chứ?
TV.TV-03: Có. Tôi chắc chắn chúng tôi sẽ vẫn là bạn thân trong nhiều năm nữa.
TV.TV-04: Có. Tôi hy vọng sẽ giữ liên lạc với cô ấy/cô ấy ngay cả sau khi hoàn thành khóa học.
TV.TV-05: Tất nhiên. Gia đình là phần quan trọng nhất trong cuộc sống của tôi.
TV.TV-06: Có. Tôi hy vọng sẽ tiếp tục làm việc với anh ấy/cô ấy và học hỏi thêm từ kinh nghiệm của anh ấy/cô ấy.

seo.metaDescription: Thực sử dụng các mẫu câu đơn giản để hỏi và trả lời.

IF.IFdes:
"MỤC TIÊU
THUẦN THỤC trả lời các câu hỏi sau (1) Bằng dạng văn bản; (2) nói trực tiếp với giáo viên
Theo format [Câu trả lời | Câu mở rộng | Câu kết mở]
"
"Person|
1 /Who are you closest to in your family?
2 /Do you have a close friend?
3 /Who do you usually spend your free time with?
4 /Who do you usually talk to when you have a problem?
5 /Is there anyone you really admire?
6 /Who has influenced you the most in your life?
7 /Have you met anyone interesting recently?
8 /Do you enjoy meeting new people?
9 /Is it easy for you to make new friends?
10 /How often do you spend time with your friends?
11 /What do you usually do with your friends?
12 /What qualities do you look for in a good friend?
13 /What kind of people do you enjoy spending time with?
14 /Do you prefer spending time with older or younger people? Why?
15 /Do you think it's important to have good friends? Why?
16 /Do you think teachers can influence students' lives?
17 /Would you like to work with your friends in the future? Why or why not?
18 /Has your relationship with your friends changed over the years?
19 /Do people make friends in the same way as they did in the past?
20 /What makes someone a good leader, teacher, or role model?"
"Place|
1	What is your favourite place in your hometown?
2	Is there a place you often go to in your free time?
3	Where do you usually go when you want to relax?
4	What is the most interesting place you have ever visited?
5	Is there a place you would like to visit again? Why?
6	What place would you recommend to tourists visiting your country?
7	Which place do you visit most often?
8	What place do you usually go to with your friends or family?
9	Is there a place that is special to you? Why?
10	What kind of places do you enjoy visiting?
11	Are there any places you don't like visiting? Why?
12	Do you prefer spending time in quiet places or crowded places? Why?
13	Have you visited any new places recently?
14	What place would you like to visit in the future?
15	Do you think your hometown is a good place to live? Why or why not?
16	Has your hometown changed much over the years?
17	Do you enjoy exploring new places? Why or why not?
18	Which place do you usually choose for studying or working?
19	Do you think people should spend more time outdoors? Why?
20	If you had a whole day off, where would you choose to go? Why?"
"Object|
1	What is your favourite object that you use every day?
2	What is one thing you couldn't live without?
3	What object do you use most often during the day?
4	Do you own anything that is very important to you?
5	What was the last useful thing you bought?
6	Is there an object you always carry with you?
7	What object do you use most at home?
8	What object helps you the most in your daily life?
9	Is there something you use every day but don't really like?
10	Have you ever received a useful object as a gift?
11	What object do you spend the most money on?
12	Is there an object you would like to replace in the future?
13	What object do you usually take with you when you travel?
14	What object is the most useful for studying or working?
15	Do you prefer buying practical objects or fashionable ones? Why?
16	Do you usually take good care of your belongings?
17	Have you ever lost something important?
18	Do you think people own too many things nowadays? Why or why not?
19	What object do you think has changed people's lives the most?
20	If you could invent a new everyday object, what would it be?"
"Activity|
1	What activity do you enjoy doing the most in your free time?
2	What activity do you do every day?
3	What activity helps you relax after a busy day?
4	What activity do you usually do at the weekend?
5	Is there an activity you never get bored of?
6	What activity do you usually do with your friends or family?
7	What activity takes up most of your time?
8	What activity do you find the most challenging?
9	Have you started any new activities recently?
10	Is there an activity you would like to do more often?
11	What activity did you enjoy when you were a child?
12	Is there an activity you no longer do? Why?
13	What activity makes you feel productive?
14	What activity do you usually do to stay healthy?
15	Do you prefer doing activities alone or with other people? Why?
16	What activity do you think is most important for students?
17	Do you think people have enough time for leisure activities nowadays? Why or why not?
18	Has the way you spend your free time changed over the years?
19	What activity would you like to learn in the future?
20	If you had more free time, what activity would you spend more time on?"
"Event|
1	What is your favourite event of the year?
2	What event do you look forward to the most every year?
3	Have you attended any interesting events recently?
4	What was the last event you attended?
5	Do you enjoy celebrating your birthday? Why or why not?
6	What family event do you enjoy the most?
7	What public event do people in your country enjoy attending?
8	Is there an event that you never miss?
9	What event would you like to attend again?
10	Have you ever taken part in a large event?
11	What event has been the most memorable in your life?
12	What kind of events do you usually attend?
13	Do you prefer small events or large events? Why?
14	Do you enjoy attending cultural festivals? Why or why not?
15	Have the events people attend changed compared with the past?
16	Do you think festivals are important for a country? Why?
17	What event would you like to experience in the future?
18	If you could attend any event in the world, what would it be?
19	Do you prefer celebrating important events with family or friends? Why?
20	Do you think people spend too much money on celebrations nowadays? Why or why not?"
"Time|
1	What time do you usually get up on weekdays?
2	What time do you usually go to bed?
3	What time of day do you feel most productive?
4	What time do you usually have breakfast?
5	How long does it usually take you to get to work or school?
6	How much time do you spend studying English each week?
7	How often do you exercise?
8	How often do you meet your friends?
9	How often do you visit your relatives?
10	When do you usually do your homework or study?
11	When do you usually have your free time?
12	What is your favourite time of the year? Why?
13	What is your favourite time of the day? Why?
14	Do you prefer doing important tasks in the morning or in the evening? Why?
15	Have your daily routines changed over the past few years?
16	Do you think you manage your time well? Why or why not?
17	Is there a time of the week that you enjoy the most?
18	When was the last time you learned something new?
19	How much time do you usually spend using your mobile phone each day?
20	If you had one extra hour every day, how would you spend it?"

IF.IFdes:
"MỤC TIÊU
THUẦN THỤC trả lời các câu hỏi sau (1) Bằng dạng văn bản; (2) nói trực tiếp với giáo viên
Theo format [Câu trả lời | Câu mở rộng | Câu kết mở]
"
"Person|
1 /Who are you closest to in your family?
2 /Do you have a close friend?
3 /Who do you usually spend your free time with?
4 /Who do you usually talk to when you have a problem?
5 /Is there anyone you really admire?
6 /Who has influenced you the most in your life?
7 /Have you met anyone interesting recently?
8 /Do you enjoy meeting new people?
9 /Is it easy for you to make new friends?
10 /How often do you spend time with your friends?
11 /What do you usually do with your friends?
12 /What qualities do you look for in a good friend?
13 /What kind of people do you enjoy spending time with?
14 /Do you prefer spending time with older or younger people? Why?
15 /Do you think it's important to have good friends? Why?
16 /Do you think teachers can influence students' lives?
17 /Would you like to work with your friends in the future? Why or why not?
18 /Has your relationship with your friends changed over the years?
19 /Do people make friends in the same way as they did in the past?
20 /What makes someone a good leader, teacher, or role model?"
"Place|
1	What is your favourite place in your hometown?
2	Is there a place you often go to in your free time?
3	Where do you usually go when you want to relax?
4	What is the most interesting place you have ever visited?
5	Is there a place you would like to visit again? Why?
6	What place would you recommend to tourists visiting your country?
7	Which place do you visit most often?
8	What place do you usually go to with your friends or family?
9	Is there a place that is special to you? Why?
10	What kind of places do you enjoy visiting?
11	Are there any places you don't like visiting? Why?
12	Do you prefer spending time in quiet places or crowded places? Why?
13	Have you visited any new places recently?
14	What place would you like to visit in the future?
15	Do you think your hometown is a good place to live? Why or why not?
16	Has your hometown changed much over the years?
17	Do you enjoy exploring new places? Why or why not?
18	Which place do you usually choose for studying or working?
19	Do you think people should spend more time outdoors? Why?
20	If you had a whole day off, where would you choose to go? Why?"
"Object|
1	What is your favourite object that you use every day?
2	What is one thing you couldn't live without?
3	What object do you use most often during the day?
4	Do you own anything that is very important to you?
5	What was the last useful thing you bought?
6	Is there an object you always carry with you?
7	What object do you use most at home?
8	What object helps you the most in your daily life?
9	Is there something you use every day but don't really like?
10	Have you ever received a useful object as a gift?
11	What object do you spend the most money on?
12	Is there an object you would like to replace in the future?
13	What object do you usually take with you when you travel?
14	What object is the most useful for studying or working?
15	Do you prefer buying practical objects or fashionable ones? Why?
16	Do you usually take good care of your belongings?
17	Have you ever lost something important?
18	Do you think people own too many things nowadays? Why or why not?
19	What object do you think has changed people's lives the most?
20	If you could invent a new everyday object, what would it be?"
"Activity|
1	What activity do you enjoy doing the most in your free time?
2	What activity do you do every day?
3	What activity helps you relax after a busy day?
4	What activity do you usually do at the weekend?
5	Is there an activity you never get bored of?
6	What activity do you usually do with your friends or family?
7	What activity takes up most of your time?
8	What activity do you find the most challenging?
9	Have you started any new activities recently?
10	Is there an activity you would like to do more often?
11	What activity did you enjoy when you were a child?
12	Is there an activity you no longer do? Why?
13	What activity makes you feel productive?
14	What activity do you usually do to stay healthy?
15	Do you prefer doing activities alone or with other people? Why?
16	What activity do you think is most important for students?
17	Do you think people have enough time for leisure activities nowadays? Why or why not?
18	Has the way you spend your free time changed over the years?
19	What activity would you like to learn in the future?
20	If you had more free time, what activity would you spend more time on?"
"Event|
1	What is your favourite event of the year?
2	What event do you look forward to the most every year?
3	Have you attended any interesting events recently?
4	What was the last event you attended?
5	Do you enjoy celebrating your birthday? Why or why not?
6	What family event do you enjoy the most?
7	What public event do people in your country enjoy attending?
8	Is there an event that you never miss?
9	What event would you like to attend again?
10	Have you ever taken part in a large event?
11	What event has been the most memorable in your life?
12	What kind of events do you usually attend?
13	Do you prefer small events or large events? Why?
14	Do you enjoy attending cultural festivals? Why or why not?
15	Have the events people attend changed compared with the past?
16	Do you think festivals are important for a country? Why?
17	What event would you like to experience in the future?
18	If you could attend any event in the world, what would it be?
19	Do you prefer celebrating important events with family or friends? Why?
20	Do you think people spend too much money on celebrations nowadays? Why or why not?"
"Time|
1	What time do you usually get up on weekdays?
2	What time do you usually go to bed?
3	What time of day do you feel most productive?
4	What time do you usually have breakfast?
5	How long does it usually take you to get to work or school?
6	How much time do you spend studying English each week?
7	How often do you exercise?
8	How often do you meet your friends?
9	How often do you visit your relatives?
10	When do you usually do your homework or study?
11	When do you usually have your free time?
12	What is your favourite time of the year? Why?
13	What is your favourite time of the day? Why?
14	Do you prefer doing important tasks in the morning or in the evening? Why?
15	Have your daily routines changed over the past few years?
16	Do you think you manage your time well? Why or why not?
17	Is there a time of the week that you enjoy the most?
18	When was the last time you learned something new?
19	How much time do you usually spend using your mobile phone each day?
20	If you had one extra hour every day, how would you spend it?"

IF.IFdes:
"MỤC TIÊU
THUẦN THỤC trả lời các câu hỏi sau (1) Bằng dạng văn bản; (2) nói trực tiếp với giáo viên
Theo format [Câu trả lời | Câu mở rộng | Câu kết mở]
"
"Person|
1 /Who are you closest to in your family?
2 /Do you have a close friend?
3 /Who do you usually spend your free time with?
4 /Who do you usually talk to when you have a problem?
5 /Is there anyone you really admire?
6 /Who has influenced you the most in your life?
7 /Have you met anyone interesting recently?
8 /Do you enjoy meeting new people?
9 /Is it easy for you to make new friends?
10 /How often do you spend time with your friends?
11 /What do you usually do with your friends?
12 /What qualities do you look for in a good friend?
13 /What kind of people do you enjoy spending time with?
14 /Do you prefer spending time with older or younger people? Why?
15 /Do you think it's important to have good friends? Why?
16 /Do you think teachers can influence students' lives?
17 /Would you like to work with your friends in the future? Why or why not?
18 /Has your relationship with your friends changed over the years?
19 /Do people make friends in the same way as they did in the past?
20 /What makes someone a good leader, teacher, or role model?"
"Place|
1	What is your favourite place in your hometown?
2	Is there a place you often go to in your free time?
3	Where do you usually go when you want to relax?
4	What is the most interesting place you have ever visited?
5	Is there a place you would like to visit again? Why?
6	What place would you recommend to tourists visiting your country?
7	Which place do you visit most often?
8	What place do you usually go to with your friends or family?
9	Is there a place that is special to you? Why?
10	What kind of places do you enjoy visiting?
11	Are there any places you don't like visiting? Why?
12	Do you prefer spending time in quiet places or crowded places? Why?
13	Have you visited any new places recently?
14	What place would you like to visit in the future?
15	Do you think your hometown is a good place to live? Why or why not?
16	Has your hometown changed much over the years?
17	Do you enjoy exploring new places? Why or why not?
18	Which place do you usually choose for studying or working?
19	Do you think people should spend more time outdoors? Why?
20	If you had a whole day off, where would you choose to go? Why?"
"Object|
1	What is your favourite object that you use every day?
2	What is one thing you couldn't live without?
3	What object do you use most often during the day?
4	Do you own anything that is very important to you?
5	What was the last useful thing you bought?
6	Is there an object you always carry with you?
7	What object do you use most at home?
8	What object helps you the most in your daily life?
9	Is there something you use every day but don't really like?
10	Have you ever received a useful object as a gift?
11	What object do you spend the most money on?
12	Is there an object you would like to replace in the future?
13	What object do you usually take with you when you travel?
14	What object is the most useful for studying or working?
15	Do you prefer buying practical objects or fashionable ones? Why?
16	Do you usually take good care of your belongings?
17	Have you ever lost something important?
18	Do you think people own too many things nowadays? Why or why not?
19	What object do you think has changed people's lives the most?
20	If you could invent a new everyday object, what would it be?"
"Activity|
1	What activity do you enjoy doing the most in your free time?
2	What activity do you do every day?
3	What activity helps you relax after a busy day?
4	What activity do you usually do at the weekend?
5	Is there an activity you never get bored of?
6	What activity do you usually do with your friends or family?
7	What activity takes up most of your time?
8	What activity do you find the most challenging?
9	Have you started any new activities recently?
10	Is there an activity you would like to do more often?
11	What activity did you enjoy when you were a child?
12	Is there an activity you no longer do? Why?
13	What activity makes you feel productive?
14	What activity do you usually do to stay healthy?
15	Do you prefer doing activities alone or with other people? Why?
16	What activity do you think is most important for students?
17	Do you think people have enough time for leisure activities nowadays? Why or why not?
18	Has the way you spend your free time changed over the years?
19	What activity would you like to learn in the future?
20	If you had more free time, what activity would you spend more time on?"
"Event|
1	What is your favourite event of the year?
2	What event do you look forward to the most every year?
3	Have you attended any interesting events recently?
4	What was the last event you attended?
5	Do you enjoy celebrating your birthday? Why or why not?
6	What family event do you enjoy the most?
7	What public event do people in your country enjoy attending?
8	Is there an event that you never miss?
9	What event would you like to attend again?
10	Have you ever taken part in a large event?
11	What event has been the most memorable in your life?
12	What kind of events do you usually attend?
13	Do you prefer small events or large events? Why?
14	Do you enjoy attending cultural festivals? Why or why not?
15	Have the events people attend changed compared with the past?
16	Do you think festivals are important for a country? Why?
17	What event would you like to experience in the future?
18	If you could attend any event in the world, what would it be?
19	Do you prefer celebrating important events with family or friends? Why?
20	Do you think people spend too much money on celebrations nowadays? Why or why not?"
"Time|
1	What time do you usually get up on weekdays?
2	What time do you usually go to bed?
3	What time of day do you feel most productive?
4	What time do you usually have breakfast?
5	How long does it usually take you to get to work or school?
6	How much time do you spend studying English each week?
7	How often do you exercise?
8	How often do you meet your friends?
9	How often do you visit your relatives?
10	When do you usually do your homework or study?
11	When do you usually have your free time?
12	What is your favourite time of the year? Why?
13	What is your favourite time of the day? Why?
14	Do you prefer doing important tasks in the morning or in the evening? Why?
15	Have your daily routines changed over the past few years?
16	Do you think you manage your time well? Why or why not?
17	Is there a time of the week that you enjoy the most?
18	When was the last time you learned something new?
19	How much time do you usually spend using your mobile phone each day?
20	If you had one extra hour every day, how would you spend it?"

HD.HD-06: Wash clothes

HD.HD-01: What activity do you usually do?
HD.HD-03: I usually play badminton in my free time.
HD.HD-04: I usually do my homework after school.
HD.HD-05: I manage a small clothing shop.
HD.HD-06: I usually wash my clothes every weekend.

HD.HD-01: How do you do it?
HD.HD-03: I play with a racket and shuttlecock at a local sports center.
HD.HD-04: I finish my assignments one by one and check my answers carefully.
HD.HD-05: I organize the staff, serve customers, and keep track of sales.
HD.HD-06: I separate the clothes by color, use a washing machine, and hang them out to dry.

HD.HD-01: When do you usually do it?
HD.HD-03: I usually play in the evening after work.
HD.HD-04: I usually do it in the evening after dinner.
HD.HD-05: I work there from morning until late afternoon.
HD.HD-06: I usually wash my clothes on Saturday mornings.

HD.HD-01: How often do you do it?
HD.HD-03: I play badminton twice a week.
HD.HD-04: I do homework every day.
HD.HD-05: I manage the shop six days a week.
HD.HD-06: I wash my clothes once or twice a week.

HD.HD-01: Who do you usually do it with?
HD.HD-03: I usually play with my friends or colleagues.
HD.HD-04: I usually do it by myself, but sometimes I study with my classmates.
HD.HD-05: I work with my employees and customers every day.
HD.HD-06: I usually do it by myself.

HD.HD-01: Why do you do it?
HD.HD-03: I do it to stay healthy and reduce stress.
HD.HD-04: I do it to improve my knowledge and get good grades.
HD.HD-05: I do it to earn a living and grow my business.
HD.HD-06: I do it to keep my clothes clean and fresh.

HD.HD-01: How do you feel when doing it?
HD.HD-03: I feel energetic and relaxed.
HD.HD-04: I feel focused, especially when I solve difficult questions.
HD.HD-05: I feel busy but satisfied when the shop runs smoothly.
HD.HD-06: I feel productive because I like keeping things clean and organized.

HD.HD-01: Can you tell me about a memorable experience?
HD.HD-03: I once won a local badminton tournament with my partner.
HD.HD-04: I once stayed up late to finish an important project and got full marks.
HD.HD-05: I successfully organized a big sales event that attracted many customers.
HD.HD-06: One time I accidentally mixed white and colored clothes, and everything turned pink.

HD.HD-01: What do you like most about this activity?
HD.HD-03: I like the exercise and the fun competition the most.
HD.HD-04: I like learning new things and challenging myself.
HD.HD-05: I enjoy meeting different customers and solving business problems.
HD.HD-06: I like the feeling of wearing clean clothes afterward.

HD.HD-01: Will you continue doing it in the future?
HD.HD-03: Yes. I want to keep playing because it's good for my health.
HD.HD-04: Yes. I'll continue doing my homework as long as I'm studying.
HD.HD-05: Yes. I hope to expand my shop and continue managing it successfully.
HD.HD-06: Yes. It's an essential household task, so I'll definitely continue doing it.

TV.TV-01: Bạn thường làm hoạt động gì?
TV.TV-03: Tôi thường chơi cầu lông vào thời gian rảnh.

TV.TV-05: Tôi quản lý một cửa hàng quần áo nhỏ.
TV.TV-06: Tôi thường giặt quần áo vào mỗi cuối tuần.

TV.TV-01: Bạn làm như thế nào?
TV.TV-03: Tôi chơi cầu lông tại một trung tâm thể thao địa phương.
TV.TV-04: Tôi hoàn thành bài tập từng cái một và kiểm tra câu trả lời cẩn thận.
TV.TV-05: Tôi sắp xếp nhân viên, phục vụ khách hàng và theo dõi doanh số bán hàng.
TV.TV-06: Tôi phân loại quần áo theo màu, sử dụng máy giặt và phơi khô.

TV.TV-01: Bạn thường làm khi nào?
TV.TV-03: Tôi thường chơi vào buổi tối sau giờ làm việc.
TV.TV-04: Tôi thường làm vào buổi tối sau bữa tối.
TV.TV-05: Tôi làm việc ở đó từ sáng đến chiều muộn.
TV.TV-06: Tôi thường giặt quần áo vào sáng thứ Bảy.

TV.TV-01: Bạn làm bao nhiêu lần?
TV.TV-03: Tôi chơi cầu lông hai lần một tuần.
TV.TV-04: Tôi làm bài tập về nhà mỗi ngày.
TV.TV-05: Tôi quản lý cửa hàng sáu ngày một tuần.
TV.TV-06: Tôi giặt quần áo một hoặc hai lần một tuần.

TV.TV-01: Bạn thường giặt với ai?
TV.TV-03: Tôi thường giặt với bạn bè hoặc đồng nghiệp.
TV.TV-04: Tôi thường giặt một mình, nhưng đôi khi tôi học với bạn cùng lớp.
TV.TV-05: Tôi làm việc với nhân viên và khách hàng mỗi ngày.
TV.TV-06: Tôi thường giặt một mình.

TV.TV-01: Tại sao bạn làm điều đó?
TV.TV-03: Tôi giặt để giữ gìn sức khỏe và giảm căng thẳng.
TV.TV-04: Tôi giặt để nâng cao kiến ​​thức và đạt điểm cao.
TV.TV-05: Tôi giặt để kiếm sống và phát triển công việc kinh doanh.
TV.TV-06: Tôi giặt để giữ quần áo sạch sẽ và thơm tho.

TV.TV-01: Bạn cảm thấy thế nào khi giặt?
TV.TV-03: Tôi cảm thấy tràn đầy năng lượng và thư giãn.
TV.TV-04: Tôi cảm thấy tập trung, đặc biệt là khi giải quyết những vấn đề khó khăn.
TV.TV-05: Tôi cảm thấy bận rộn nhưng hài lòng khi cửa hàng hoạt động trơn tru.
TV.TV-06: Tôi cảm thấy hiệu quả vì tôi thích giữ mọi thứ sạch sẽ và ngăn nắp.

TV.TV-01: Bạn có thể kể cho tôi về một trải nghiệm đáng nhớ không?
TV.TV-03: Tôi từng thắng một giải cầu lông địa phương với người bạn đồng hành của mình.
TV.TV-04: Tôi từng thức khuya để hoàn thành một dự án quan trọng và đạt điểm tuyệt đối.
TV.TV-05: Tôi đã tổ chức thành công một sự kiện bán hàng lớn thu hút rất nhiều khách hàng.
TV.TV-06: Có lần tôi vô tình trộn lẫn quần áo trắng và quần áo màu, và tất cả đều chuyển sang màu hồng.

TV.TV-01: Bạn thích nhất điều gì ở hoạt động này?
TV.TV-03: Tôi thích nhất việc tập thể dục và cuộc thi vui vẻ.
TV.TV-04: Tôi thích học hỏi những điều mới và thử thách bản thân.
TV.TV-05: Tôi thích gặp gỡ những khách hàng khác nhau và giải quyết các vấn đề kinh doanh.
TV.TV-06: Tôi thích cảm giác được mặc quần áo sạch sẽ sau đó.

TV.TV-01: Bạn sẽ tiếp tục làm việc này trong tương lai chứ?
TV.TV-03: Có. Tôi muốn tiếp tục làm vì nó tốt cho sức khỏe của tôi.
TV.TV-04: Có. Tôi sẽ tiếp tục làm bài tập về nhà miễn là tôi còn đang học.
TV.TV-05: Có. Tôi hy vọng sẽ mở rộng cửa hàng của mình và tiếp tục quản lý nó thành công.
TV.TV-06: Có. Đó là một việc nhà thiết yếu, vì vậy tôi chắc chắn sẽ tiếp tục làm.

TV.TV-01: Câu hỏi
TV.TV-03: Sinh nhật
TV.TV-04: Lễ tốt nghiệp
TV.TV-05: Hội nghị

TV.TV-01: Sự kiện đó là gì?
TV.TV-03: Đó là bữa tiệc sinh nhật của người bạn thân nhất của tôi.
TV.TV-04: Đó là lễ tốt nghiệp đại học của tôi.
TV.TV-05: Đó là một hội nghị kinh doanh quốc tế.
TV.TV-06: Đó là một lễ hội văn hóa truyền thống ở quê hương tôi.

TV.TV-01: Sự kiện đó diễn ra khi nào?
TV.TV-03: Nó diễn ra vào tháng trước.
TV.TV-04: Nó xảy ra cách đây hai năm.
TV.TV-05: Nó được tổ chức vào cuối tuần trước.
TV.TV-06: Nó diễn ra trong kỳ nghỉ Tết Nguyên đán.

TV.TV-01: Sự kiện đó diễn ra ở đâu?
TV.TV-03: Nó được tổ chức tại một nhà hàng địa phương.
TV.TV-04: Nó diễn ra tại khuôn viên trường đại học của tôi.
TV.TV-05: Nó được tổ chức tại một trung tâm hội nghị lớn.
TV.TV-06: Nó diễn ra ở trung tâm thành phố.

TV.TV-01: Ai đã tham dự sự kiện?
TV.TV-03: Bạn bè và gia đình tôi đã tham dự bữa tiệc.
TV.TV-04: Bạn cùng lớp, thầy cô và các thành viên trong gia đình tôi đã tham dự buổi lễ.
TV.TV-05: Các chuyên gia kinh doanh, diễn giả và đại diện công ty đã tham dự hội nghị.
TV.TV-06: Cư dân địa phương và nhiều khách du lịch đã tham dự lễ hội.

TV.TV-01: Điều gì đã xảy ra trong sự kiện?
TV.TV-03: Chúng tôi đã ăn tối, chơi trò chơi và hát chúc mừng sinh nhật.
TV.TV-04: Chúng tôi đã nhận bằng tốt nghiệp, chụp ảnh và cùng nhau ăn mừng.
TV.TV-05: Có các bài thuyết trình, thảo luận nhóm và các buổi giao lưu.
TV.TV-06: Có các tiết mục biểu diễn truyền thống, các gian hàng ẩm thực và pháo hoa.

TV.TV-01: Khoảnh khắc đáng nhớ nhất là gì?
TV.TV-03: Khoảnh khắc đáng nhớ nhất là khi mọi người bất ngờ tặng bạn tôi một chiếc bánh sinh nhật.
TV.TV-04: Khoảnh khắc đáng nhớ nhất là khi bước lên sân khấu để nhận bằng tốt nghiệp.
TV.TV-05: Bài phát biểu quan trọng của một doanh nhân nổi tiếng là điểm nhấn của hội nghị.
TV.TV-06: Màn trình diễn pháo hoa vào buổi tối là phần đáng nhớ nhất của lễ hội.

TV.TV-01: Bạn cảm thấy thế nào?
TV.TV-03: Tôi cảm thấy hạnh phúc và hào hứng.
TV.TV-04: Tôi cảm thấy tự hào và xúc động.
TV.TV-05: Tôi cảm thấy được truyền cảm hứng và động lực.
TV.TV-06: Tôi cảm thấy vui vẻ và kinh ngạc.

TV.TV-01: Kết quả hoặc thành quả là gì?
TV.TV-03: Chúng tôi đã có một khoảng thời gian tuyệt vời bên nhau và tạo ra những kỷ niệm tuyệt vời.
TV.TV-04: Tôi đã chính thức tốt nghiệp và ăn mừng cùng gia đình.
TV.TV-05: Tôi đã học được nhiều ý tưởng hữu ích và tạo dựng được những mối quan hệ chuyên nghiệp có giá trị.
TV.TV-06: Tôi đã tìm hiểu thêm về các truyền thống địa phương và tận hưởng một trải nghiệm văn hóa đáng nhớ.

TV.TV-01: Bạn thích nhất điều gì về sự kiện này?
TV.TV-03: Tôi thích không khí vui vẻ và dành thời gian với mọi người.
TV.TV-04: Tôi thích việc cùng các bạn cùng lớp ăn mừng cột mốc quan trọng này.
TV.TV-05: Tôi thích được gặp gỡ các chuyên gia và học hỏi từ kinh nghiệm của họ.
TV.TV-06: Tôi thích nhất là các tiết mục biểu diễn truyền thống và các món ăn địa phương ngon tuyệt.

TV.TV-01: Bạn có muốn tham dự một sự kiện tương tự nữa không?
TV.TV-03: Có. Tôi rất muốn tham dự thêm nhiều buổi tiệc sinh nhật với bạn bè.
TV.TV-04: Có. Tôi muốn tham dự các lễ tốt nghiệp trong tương lai để ủng hộ bạn bè hoặc gia đình.
TV.TV-05: Chắc chắn rồi. Tôi rất muốn tham dự thêm nhiều hội nghị để học hỏi và mở rộng mạng lưới quan hệ của mình.
TV.TV-06: Có. Tôi rất muốn tham gia thêm nhiều lễ hội văn hóa trong tương lai.

seo.metaDescription: Thực sử dụng các mẫu câu đơn giản để hỏi và trả lời.

IF.IFdes:
"MỤC TIÊU
THUẦN THỤC trả lời các câu hỏi sau (1) Bằng dạng văn bản; (2) nói trực tiếp với giáo viên
Theo format [Câu trả lời | Câu mở rộng | Câu kết mở]
"
"Person|
1 /Who are you closest to in your family?
2 /Do you have a close friend?
3 /Who do you usually spend your free time with?
4 /Who do you usually talk to when you have a problem?
5 /Is there anyone you really admire?
6 /Who has influenced you the most in your life?
7 /Have you met anyone interesting recently?
8 /Do you enjoy meeting new people?
9 /Is it easy for you to make new friends?
10 /How often do you spend time with your friends?
11 /What do you usually do with your friends?
12 /What qualities do you look for in a good friend?
13 /What kind of people do you enjoy spending time with?
14 /Do you prefer spending time with older or younger people? Why?
15 /Do you think it's important to have good friends? Why?
16 /Do you think teachers can influence students' lives?
17 /Would you like to work with your friends in the future? Why or why not?
18 /Has your relationship with your friends changed over the years?
19 /Do people make friends in the same way as they did in the past?
20 /What makes someone a good leader, teacher, or role model?"
"Place|
1	What is your favourite place in your hometown?
2	Is there a place you often go to in your free time?
3	Where do you usually go when you want to relax?
4	What is the most interesting place you have ever visited?
5	Is there a place you would like to visit again? Why?
6	What place would you recommend to tourists visiting your country?
7	Which place do you visit most often?
8	What place do you usually go to with your friends or family?
9	Is there a place that is special to you? Why?
10	What kind of places do you enjoy visiting?
11	Are there any places you don't like visiting? Why?
12	Do you prefer spending time in quiet places or crowded places? Why?
13	Have you visited any new places recently?
14	What place would you like to visit in the future?
15	Do you think your hometown is a good place to live? Why or why not?
16	Has your hometown changed much over the years?
17	Do you enjoy exploring new places? Why or why not?
18	Which place do you usually choose for studying or working?
19	Do you think people should spend more time outdoors? Why?
20	If you had a whole day off, where would you choose to go? Why?"
"Object|
1	What is your favourite object that you use every day?
2	What is one thing you couldn't live without?
3	What object do you use most often during the day?
4	Do you own anything that is very important to you?
5	What was the last useful thing you bought?
6	Is there an object you always carry with you?
7	What object do you use most at home?
8	What object helps you the most in your daily life?
9	Is there something you use every day but don't really like?
10	Have you ever received a useful object as a gift?
11	What object do you spend the most money on?
12	Is there an object you would like to replace in the future?
13	What object do you usually take with you when you travel?
14	What object is the most useful for studying or working?
15	Do you prefer buying practical objects or fashionable ones? Why?
16	Do you usually take good care of your belongings?
17	Have you ever lost something important?
18	Do you think people own too many things nowadays? Why or why not?
19	What object do you think has changed people's lives the most?
20	If you could invent a new everyday object, what would it be?"
"Activity|
1	What activity do you enjoy doing the most in your free time?
2	What activity do you do every day?
3	What activity helps you relax after a busy day?
4	What activity do you usually do at the weekend?
5	Is there an activity you never get bored of?
6	What activity do you usually do with your friends or family?
7	What activity takes up most of your time?
8	What activity do you find the most challenging?
9	Have you started any new activities recently?
10	Is there an activity you would like to do more often?
11	What activity did you enjoy when you were a child?
12	Is there an activity you no longer do? Why?
13	What activity makes you feel productive?
14	What activity do you usually do to stay healthy?
15	Do you prefer doing activities alone or with other people? Why?
16	What activity do you think is most important for students?
17	Do you think people have enough time for leisure activities nowadays? Why or why not?
18	Has the way you spend your free time changed over the years?
19	What activity would you like to learn in the future?
20	If you had more free time, what activity would you spend more time on?"
"Event|
1	What is your favourite event of the year?
2	What event do you look forward to the most every year?
3	Have you attended any interesting events recently?
4	What was the last event you attended?
5	Do you enjoy celebrating your birthday? Why or why not?
6	What family event do you enjoy the most?
7	What public event do people in your country enjoy attending?
8	Is there an event that you never miss?
9	What event would you like to attend again?
10	Have you ever taken part in a large event?
11	What event has been the most memorable in your life?
12	What kind of events do you usually attend?
13	Do you prefer small events or large events? Why?
14	Do you enjoy attending cultural festivals? Why or why not?
15	Have the events people attend changed compared with the past?
16	Do you think festivals are important for a country? Why?
17	What event would you like to experience in the future?
18	If you could attend any event in the world, what would it be?
19	Do you prefer celebrating important events with family or friends? Why?
20	Do you think people spend too much money on celebrations nowadays? Why or why not?"
"Time|
1	What time do you usually get up on weekdays?
2	What time do you usually go to bed?
3	What time of day do you feel most productive?
4	What time do you usually have breakfast?
5	How long does it usually take you to get to work or school?
6	How much time do you spend studying English each week?
7	How often do you exercise?
8	How often do you meet your friends?
9	How often do you visit your relatives?
10	When do you usually do your homework or study?
11	When do you usually have your free time?
12	What is your favourite time of the year? Why?
13	What is your favourite time of the day? Why?
14	Do you prefer doing important tasks in the morning or in the evening? Why?
15	Have your daily routines changed over the past few years?
16	Do you think you manage your time well? Why or why not?
17	Is there a time of the week that you enjoy the most?
18	When was the last time you learned something new?
